mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_media (user_id, itinerary_id, place_id, region, title, media_type, file_path, file_size, upload_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itineraryId}, #{placeId}, #{region}, #{title}, #{mediaType}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{uploadTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM travel_media WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM travel_media WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_media SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE travel_media SET deleted = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM travel_media WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 1 ORDER BY update_time DESC
